verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a hardware system-on-chip, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a software workflow feature outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships any automation-management capability. The evidence covers only performance, memory, connectivity, display, and ML/GPU frameworks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
